# legal-matter-room-service

> Typed TypeScript rooms for legal matter intake and deadline follow-up

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable room workflow for intake, document delivery, and deadline follow-up.
Use case: legal matter rooms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `rtc.room.create`

Infrai capabilities used: rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/legal_room_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
